stable.notes: Right-click the pet to hide it or change how much it moves: Full motion, Calm motion or No motion. The pet now shows Codex threads that are working and Cursor chats mid-turn, and the Sessions pane parks a message on a busy thread the way the pet does. Pairs with server 6.51.0.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
